sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.3-Flash-UNCENSORED-FP8 is a weight-edited, uncensored FP8 release of GLM-5.3-Flash from dealignai. The release removes refusal behavior from the tensors rather than using prompts, fine-tuning, LoRA, adapters, steering vectors, runtime hooks, or a custom model file.
